name: logninv
expr: x_def = logninv(0.5); x_s = logninv(0.5, 0, 1); x_v = logninv(qs, 0, 1); x_q0 = logninv(0, 0, 1); x_q1 = logninv(1, 0, 1); x_qneg = logninv(-0.1, 0, 1); x_qover = logninv(1.5, 0, 1); x_sig0 = logninv(0.5, 0, 0); x_signeg = logninv(0.5, 0, -1);
comment: Sig: x = logninv(p[, mu, sigma]). Inverse Lognormal CDF. Defaults mu=0, sigma=1. q=0 → 0; q=1 → Inf; q outside [0,1] → NaN. sigma<=0 → NaN.
